about: Prose input + choice questions (first designed in the playground, then tuned with tools/proseprobe.mjs, tools/dirprobe.mjs and headless flights). One /v1/systemone call per decision with all questions; state = perception prose, one line per element: where the pad is (side stated twice), drift toward/away from it, altitude/descent, terrain clearance toward the pad. pad_choice is asked in its own call in the pads layout. Decomposed variant: the thrust choice is split into altitude_band, descent_rate and the warning ridge_in_the_way (true = trouble); code combines them with the THRUST_TABLE in prose.mjs.

flight_direction.instructions: Determine whether to fly to the right or to the left to get over the pad

criteria.right: fly to the right, toward the pad that is off to your right
criteria.left: fly to the left, toward the pad that is off to your left
criteria.none: no need to fly left or right because you are directly above the pad

flight_velocity.instructions: Determine how fast to fly sideways based on how far off the pad is

criteria.fast: fly fast if the pad is far off or way in the distance
criteria.slow: fly slowly if the pad is a fair way off
criteria.very_slow: fly very slowly if the pad is close, just off to one side
criteria.none: no sideways speed needed if you are directly above the pad

altitude_band.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander. Determine how high the lander is above the landing pad.

criteria.high: the lander is at high altitude
criteria.medium: the lander is at medium altitude
criteria.low: the lander is near the ground (low altitude), about to touch down, or below the level of the pad

descent_rate.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander. Determine how fast the lander is coming down.

criteria.fast: the lander is descending fast or very fast
criteria.slow: the lander is descending slowly or very slowly

ridge_in_the_way.instructions: Is a ridge in the way, higher than the lander?

criteria.true: trouble: there is a ridge ahead, higher than you
criteria.false: no trouble: the ground between you and the pad is clear, or the ridge ahead is just below your height

question.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander and must choose which landing pad to aim for. Weigh the reward points against the risk: how far the pad is, how much fuel is left, and how hard the pad is to land on. A pad that is higher than you or behind a ridge costs a lot of fuel to reach. When fuel is low, choose the nearest pad you can reach. Keep heading for the current pad unless another pad is clearly better.

criteria.narrow: the narrow pad: ×2 points, a good choice when it is near and there is enough fuel
criteria.wide: the wide pad: ×1 points, the safe choice when the other pads are far or hard to reach
criteria.ridge: the ridge pad: ×3 points, worth it only with plenty of fuel when it is near and not higher than you

final_approach.about: Asked instead of `questions` in the final-approach zone (below 18 m over the target pad, within 15 m of its edges). The state then describes where the legs are relative to the pad edges, height, sink rate, sideways slide and lean. legs_about_to_touch is the model's own touchdown call: when it says yes (≥ 0.9), the lander stops leaning and comes down upright.

flight_direction.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander in the last few meters above the landing pad. Determine which way to move sideways so the legs come down on the middle of the pad and you are not sliding when you touch down

criteria.right: move right when the pad, or the middle of the pad, is off to your right, or when you are sliding to the left away from the middle of the pad
criteria.left: move left when the pad, or the middle of the pad, is off to your left, or when you are sliding to the right away from the middle of the pad
criteria.none: hold still sideways when your legs are over the middle of the pad, or when you are already sliding toward the pad or toward the middle of the pad

flight_velocity.instructions: Determine how much sideways speed you want in the last few meters before touching down

criteria.very_slow: a little sideways speed only when you are nearly still sideways and the pad, or the middle of the pad, is off to one side
criteria.none: no sideways speed when your legs are over the middle of the pad, when you are sliding sideways, or when you are almost touching the pad

downward_thrust_magnitude.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander in the last few meters above the landing pad. Determine the thrust needed so the lander touches down gently

criteria.large: a lot of thrust is needed because the lander is dropping hard
criteria.medium: some thrust is needed because the lander is dropping fast
criteria.small: very little thrust is needed because the lander is sinking steadily or settling gently
criteria.none: no thrust is needed because the lander is rising

legs_about_to_touch.instructions: Are the lander's legs about to touch the pad?

criteria.true: yes: you are almost touching the pad, or a couple of meters above the pad
criteria.false: no: you are a few meters, a little way or some way above the pad
